name: Cardify
tagline: A math mistake notebook for middle and high school students
description: Cardify helps middle and high school students revisit missed math questions on iPhone and iPad. Photograph a problem and your original work, then compare your attempt with a step-by-step solution. Save questions by topic and print selected problems for another practice session. Parents can use the saved questions to help their child prepare for the next math test. Cardify is free to download and offers optional in-app purchases.
